patterns.what_was_hard: The brief's done-criterion ('no site carries the false claim') and its scope ('DO NOT touch classes/warrior.lua') cannot both hold: the last false claim lives in classes/warrior.lua. patterns.skill_gap: A brief that lists the remaining sites can still be incomplete. The sweep (grep the phrase tree-wide) is cheap and should be part of the lane, not an optional extra.
